about: Short made-up calls with known words, for transcription and recording tests. Each turn: who (me = the mic track, anyone else = the remote track), text, lang, and gap (seconds of silence before it). Voices: azure:<voice> (gpt-4o-mini-tts, English) or eleven:<voice id> (eleven_multilingual_v2, Ukrainian and Russian). People and companies are invented.

conversations.title: Acme weekly sync
conversations.what: A client call: a decision and two action items with owners and dates.

turns.text: Morning Dana, let's go through the single sign-on rollout.
Sure. We still need the SSO checklist from you, ideally by the end of today.
I'll send the checklist this afternoon, before four o'clock.
Great. And the pilot, do we start with the Berlin office or with Madrid?
Let's agree on Berlin first. Madrid follows two weeks later.
Agreed, Berlin first. I'll book the training room for Thursday.

conversations.title: Globex pilot kickoff
conversations.what: Two people on the remote side (one track, two voices) and the user; numbers and names.

turns.text: Hi everyone, Omar is joining us from the security team today.
Hello. I have three questions about data retention, it's a short list.
Go ahead, Omar. We keep transcripts for ninety days by default.
Ninety days works. Can the audio be deleted right after transcription?
Yes, the audio is deleted as soon as the transcript is written.
Then I'll send the pilot plan to both of you by Friday.

conversations.title: Initech planning
conversations.what: Ukrainian, Russian and English in one call: a call has one language, so this one is for a language pinned for a call (each line then in it).

turns.text: Привіт, Олено. Давай швидко пройдемося по плану на наступний тиждень.
Привет. У меня два вопроса: бюджет на обучение и сроки по пилоту.
Бюджет вже погоджений. Пілот стартує в понеділок, їй-богу без затримок.
Чудово, тоді я підготую звіт і надішлю його до середи.
And please copy Dana on that report, she asked for it.

conversations.title: Initech budget check
conversations.what: A call in Ukrainian only (mixed-languages' Ukrainian lines, the same clips): with en, uk and ru allowed it must come out in Ukrainian.

conversations.title: Initech questions
conversations.what: A call in Russian only (mixed-languages' Russian line, said twice: the same clip): with en, uk and ru allowed it must come out in Russian.

turns.text: Привет. У меня два вопроса: бюджет на обучение и сроки по пилоту.
Привет. У меня два вопроса: бюджет на обучение и сроки по пилоту.

conversations.title: Waiting for the demo
conversations.what: Twenty seconds in which nobody speaks; nothing may be transcribed there.

turns.text: Let me share my screen, give me a moment to find the right window.
I can see it now. The dashboard looks much cleaner than last week.
Thanks, we removed two of the old charts.

conversations.title: Quick check
conversations.what: Under twenty seconds: transcribed, but too short for automatic minutes.

turns.text: Quick one: is the call at three still on?
Yes, three o'clock, same link.

conversations.title: Acme and Globex catch-up
conversations.what: Over three minutes and 1,500 characters, long enough for automatic minutes: acme-sync and two-remotes three times over (the same clips).
